storyCards.headline: On On: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Erykah Badu's "On On" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. Erica Abi Wright (born February 26, 1971), known professionally as Erykah Badu, is an American singer, songwriter, record producer, and actress.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

On On was released in 1997.
